summary: Iteration 2 — Rebrand + Min-order ₹5,000 verification. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass serially (auth, shops, products with new MonthlyMart catalog, cart including min_order=5000 & delivery_fee=0 & platform_fee=0, checkout blocked <5000 with 400+detail containing '5000', checkout ≥5000 succeeds with delivery_otp, admin, roles, AI). Frontend UI: Landing renders correctly with MonthlyMart brand, 'Upto 20% OFF · Monthly Groceries' badge, 'Your monthly groceries, delivered home.' headline, 'Within 4 hours' card, 'Minimum order ₹5,000'; Login shows 'Welcome back to MonthlyMart.', Register shows 'Join MonthlyMart.', Product Detail shows 'Delivery within 4 hours' + 'Minimum order value ₹5,000'; Cart shows amber min-order warning + disabled 'Rs X away from minimum' button when subtotal<5000. Backend seeded catalog has all 14 required monthly grocery products with no produce/meat/fish. However, several REBRAND LEAKS remain: consumer Home still lists 'Fruits & Veggies' and 'Meat & Fish' categories in UI; Landing hero

minor.issue: System prompt still contains the word 'freshness/quality'. Not user-visible, but review request bans the word 'fresh' anywhere in shipped code.

Product name 'Colgate MaxFresh Toothpaste 750g' contains the substring 'Fresh'. Review spec listed it simply as 'Colgate 750g'. Consider renaming to 'Colgate MaxFresh' → 'Colgate Max Protection 750g' or similar to avoid the word 'Fresh'.

ui_bugs.issue: Still includes 'Fruits & Veggies' and 'Meat & Fish' categories, rendered on the /shop page carousel. Review request explicitly forbids these — the catalog is monthly grocery only. Replace with Atta & Rice, Pulses & Grains, Cooking Essentials, Dairy Staples, Beverages, Snacks, Household, Personal Care, Instant Food.
Hero image uses alt="Fresh groceries" — the word 'Fresh' is forbidden. Change alt to something like 'Monthly grocery aisle'.

Empty-shop state still renders

Welcome to Zopin

. Change to 'Welcome to MonthlyMart'.
Copy reads 'This information appears to consumers browsing on Zopin.' — should say 'browsing on MonthlyMart.'
Featured-products empty state body says 'Explore shops below to discover fresh arrivals.' — remove 'fresh'.

Browser tab shows 'Emergent | Fullstack App' at runtime — the template <title>MonthlyMart · Monthly Groceries Delivered Home</title> is being overridden by /scripts/emergent-main.js after page load. Set the title dynamically in a top-level React effect (document.title = 'MonthlyMart · Monthly Groceries Delivered Home') or override after the script runs. Currently the tab title fails the acceptance criteria.

Seeded products render generic bread/bakery stock images that don't match the product (e.g., Aashirvaad Atta 10kg shows an image of bread loaves). Not a rebrand blocker but visually mis-leading; consider curated product photos.

Order detail page renders the delivery OTP prominently in a green card for every status except cancelled/rejected/refunded — matches spec.

Admin login email in Login.js quick-select is 'admin@zopin.com' (needed to log the admin in — matches seeded creds). OK to leave.
MongoDB _id excluded correctly in all _*_out helpers.

IMPORTANT: run it serially (`python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v -o addopts=''`) — pytest.ini defaults to xdist parallelism which causes cross-worker cart contamination between test_full_flow and other consumer tests, producing a false negative for '5000' in the 400 detail. All 20 tests pass when serial. Frontend rebrand leaks documented above; when those are fixed, re-verify by grepping the running bundle for 'fresh', 'zopin', '15 min' with case-insensitive match.
rca of the issue: Rebrand was executed on the primary user-facing surfaces (Landing hero copy, Login/Register hero copy, Cart, Product Detail, OrderDetail, backend cart/order routes with MIN_ORDER=5000) but a handful of secondary surfaces were missed: (1) CATEGORIES const in consumer/Home.js still contains the pre-rebrand fresh categories, (2) hero in Landing.js not updated, (3) merchant Dashboard empty state + ShopProfile description still hardcode 'Zopin', (4) emergent-main.js overrides at runtime — needs a React-side document.title override, (5) 'Colgate MaxFresh' seed product name accidentally contains 'Fresh', (6) AI system prompt contains 'freshness'. No functional/API bugs — all business rules are enforced correctly.
